text:
Happy Hangul Day 🇰🇷

Tell me who you are in plain English and I'll give you a Korean name with real hanja meaning.

"calm like the ocean, protective of my family" → 해진 海鎭: 海 the sea, 鎭 to guard.

Drop a description below and I'll name you 👇

Oppa, unnie, hyung, noona: the word depends on YOUR gender, not just their age.

Woman → older man: 오빠. Man → older man: 형.
Same birth year? You're 친구. At work? 선배 or name + 씨.

So… can you call your bias oppa? 👀
reply: Put in your birthday and any idol (or friend): hellonunchi.com/tools/what-do-i-call-them/

text:
Your bias' "Korean age" is why every fan wiki disagrees.

Jungkook, born 1 Sep 1997: 29 international, 30 in Korean age, 29 by year age. All correct.

Who should I run next?

You're buying too much data for Korea.

10 days of Naver Maps, KakaoTalk, Papago, Instagram and a bit of YouTube is usually 5–8 GB, not 20.

Tell me your trip length and how you use your phone, I'll tell you the GB 👇

Shopping in Korea? Spend ₩15,000+ in one receipt at a TAX FREE store and you can get part of the VAT back.

Many stores do it on the spot for purchases under ₩1,000,000 — just show your passport. After fees it's usually 5–8%, not the full 10%.

Ever forgotten to claim yours?
reply: See what you'd get back on your shopping list: hellonunchi.com/tools/korea-tax-refund-calculator/

text:
Hangul keyboards put consonants on the left and vowels on the right, so your hands take turns. That's why Koreans who type all day hit 300+ keystrokes a minute.

Most learners start around 60–100. Take the test and comment your score, no lying 😅
